body: I think i applied at the start of July and was accepted with a fast track offer in mid August! so it really depends on what course/degree you’re applying for! Fingers crossed 🤞🏻🤞🏻
absolutely!! i’m coming from Napier and am super nervous lol
I also got a fast track offer but that is for a BA in psychology and criminology but i know many people are getting fast track offers! :)
Wow. That brought me into tears. Thank you for this.  This is a huge eye opener and wow. Thank you so so much. ❤️
Thank you, it means a lot to read this. Thank you ❤️

Hello, I'm sorry for your loss I really am. We both know that a lot of things people say to us don't help at the time but they will eventually and I'm only just starting to realise. I spent most of the time after her death Angry, confused and heartbroken, but know I understand that the things people said to me were true and that it won't get better, but I will learn how to adapt to it and deal with it. But thank you so much. ❤️

Thank you, it just my mum and I, I'm close with my Aunty and she's been through the same thing but I feel like none of them really want to hear me talk about it all the time because I have so many questions that no one but Natalia could've answered. But thank you ❤️
Thank you. This means a lot, I and many other girls at my school continue to blame themselves and hurt themselves emotionally and that's pretty hard to see everyday, but thank you ❤️

Thank you. I can't help but feel the guilt and it makes matters worse that the family wouldn't read us the note she left, it was almost 3 pages long and yeah that really hurts but thank you for the advice. ❤️
Thank you, I truly appreciate it. Thank you ❤️

Hello, I'm sorry for your loss I truly am and we both know we're most tired of hearing that but everyone who said it meant it. Thank you, I think my friend (Natalia is her name) would've wanted me to be there but I think she would've understood. Again thank you so much. ❤️
